articles.headline: Fourteen learners from Chikwawa South East Constituency who have been selected to boarding secondary schools
articles.preview: Fourteen learners from Chikwawa South East Constituency who have been selected to boarding secondary schools across the country
articles.content: Fourteen learners from Chikwawa South East Constituency who have been selected to boarding secondary schools across the country have received learning materials from Member of Parliament Susan Dossi. Dossi made the donation today, saying the gesture is intended to recognise the learners’ hard work and encourage them to remain committed to their education. The support includes school bags, notebooks and other essential learning materials. Dossi says the initiative also seeks to continue the legacy of her late father, Moses Dossi, who supported learners in the constituency during his time as MP. The beneficiaries include learners selected to Blantyre Secondary School, Mzuzu Government Secondary School and Ngabu Secondary School, among others. Meanwhile, Dossi says the identification of learners to benefit from school-fee support through the Constituency Development Fund (CDF) is progressing well and will soon be completed in the constituency.

articles.headline: Shadric Namalomba today officially opened a girls’ hostel
articles.preview: Mangochi South East Member of Parliament and Minister of Information Shadric Namalomba has today officially opened a girls’ hostel
articles.content: Mangochi South East Member of Parliament and Minister of Information Shadric Namalomba has today officially opened a girls’ hostel at Chilipa Community Day Secondary School in Mangochi. Constructed with funding from the Governance to Enable Service Delivery (GESD) programme, the hostel has capacity to accommodate more than 50 girls. The facility is expected to improve girls’ access to secondary education by providing accommodation closer to the school, particularly for learners who previously travelled long distances to attend classes.
